content.value: Determine the steady state temperature distribution $u ( r , \theta )$ in a semi-circular plate of radius 18 $\cdot _ { b } \cdot$ cm with insulated faces. The boundary diameter is kept at $0 \%$ and the temperature on the circumference is prescribed by $u ( b , \theta ) = k \theta ( \pi - \theta )$ when $0 \leq \theta \leq \pi$
